name: counterparts
description: The Counterparts sidebar mod on its own, for `claude plugin test hooks/sidebar` and `tsc -p hooks/sidebar`. The plugin at the repository root loads the same module (hooks/hooks.json, "modules"); this folder only gives its tests a plugin root that holds nothing else. Named counterparts so its $.state keys are the same either way. The counterparts-sidebar plugin is built from this folder (tools/plugin-bundle/build.ts --flavor sidebar), which writes those keys out under its own name.
